integrity: The first public date and primary MSC 03E05 were verified from the arXiv record. The primary full text was inspected at the one-cardinal definitions, pruning lemmas, and Theorem 3.13. The singular-height argument was reconstructed independently with removal ranks and explicit cofinality bookkeeping; no computation or experimental evidence is used.
scientific_limitations: The cofinality condition is sufficient and is not claimed to be sharp. The theorem does not cover singular heights of small cofinality relative to the subsystem width, does not extend the source's two-cardinal theorem, and yields a well-pruned subtree rather than a cofinal branch.
title: Narrow-system pruning depends on cofinality, not regularity
